comments.name: GlobalCitizen
comments.content: Regarding the German robot incident, it's a profound ethical dilemma that crosses borders. In many European countries, data privacy and AI ethics are top priorities. The difficulty in determining responsibility—is it the robot's programmer, its owner, or an intrinsic flaw in the AI itself—highlights the urgent need for international legislation and a robust framework for AI development. This isn't just about 'remote control'; it's about defining the 'human in the loop' for autonomous systems and setting precedents for future AI-related crimes. Such cases make you really think about the boundaries of technology and human accountability. It's a wake-up call, frankly.

comments.name: 李老师很严肃
comments.content: 关于那个机器人事件，我认为这不仅仅是技术问题，更是道德底线问题。我们现在教育孩子，除了知识，更要注重品德和法律意识的培养。无论科技如何发展，人类的伦理道德和对生命的尊重绝不能被机器或技术滥用所侵蚀。对于这种涉嫌远程操控的案件，警方务必深入调查，严惩不贷，给社会一个明确的警示，保护未成年人健康成长环境。

comments.name: 李科长
